review.why: Scores a LinkedIn profile out of 100 on a 12-part rubric, then rewrites the weakest parts first.
review.summary: Scores a pasted LinkedIn profile against a 12-item rubric and rewrites what loses points, in order: headline, first lines of About, About body, Featured, experience, banner. Output is a score table, copy-ready rewrites and an honest re-score.
strengths: Fixes are ordered by points lost
Asks for honest scores (most profiles land in the 30s-40s)
Never logs in to LinkedIn: the user pastes each section
cautions: Depends on a rubric file that is not read in this review
Calls a /li-human step that is not part of this folder
LinkedIn only: no resume or cover letter content
